items.title: Còn8file merge conflict G0–main/ML
items.resolution: Resolved all eight G0/main conflicts, preserving strict G0 guards and the frozen ML contract.

items.title: SDN/G0 mới chưa được hội tụ vào main
items.resolution: SDN and G0 are integrated in the local repair branch. Remote main and branch PRs have not been changed.

items.title: Merge trực tiếp G0–SDN có20modify/delete conflict
items.resolution: Integrated SDN through main before G0; preserved SDN files instead of direct modify/delete merging.

items.title: run config_hash và optimizer parameter hash vẫn lẫn namespace
items.resolution: Separated run config_hash from optimizer_config_hash; propagated run version/hash and preserved native topology hash.

items.title: Thiếu mapper manifest Network → RunCreate/runtime context
items.resolution: Added manifest_to_run with actual explicit origins, RunCreate validation and frozen L/H/model metadata.

items.title: Runner đóng vòng vẫn chưa triển khai
items.resolution: Added sequential Runner with registration, readiness, tick deadlines, backpressure, durable audit, recovery and drain. Native whole-system launch still requires CF-39.

items.title: Thiếu ID vẫn sinh run_default/snap_default
items.resolution: Reject missing run/snapshot IDs; removed run_default and snap_default from serializers.

items.title: H1/Δ1 vẫn nhận window UTC5giây; fixture test dùng Δ10
items.resolution: Validate UTC duration H*delta, bin anchor and row windows. Optimization test fixture now uses production delta=1.

items.title: Data READY forecast chưa có bounds/origin/deadline cho planner
items.resolution: Added READY envelope adapter binding Data forecast to registered run/snapshot/routing and deriving bounds/deadline from the actual target.

items.title: Audit tick đã có code nhưng chưa có sink bền vững được cấu hình chung
items.resolution: Runner SQLite audit freezes every tick before delivery and checkpoints ACK; optimizer JSONL flushes and fsyncs.

items.title: Journal có thể ghi đè batch chưa resolve; recovery chưa bắt buộc
items.resolution: Outstanding apply journal cannot be overwritten or silently replaced after corruption. Recover before new work; Runner takes exclusive OS lock. Native wrapped SDN job responses are handled.

items.title: G0 chưa nạp/verify selected.yaml như hợp đồng ML trên main
items.resolution: Verify frozen YAML against model/config bytes and metadata; bind H and preserve final forecast values without a second epsilon.

items.title: Chốt lịch tick đầu và audit các tick thiếu lịch sử
items.resolution: Implemented existing nonnegative-bin policy: skip/audit until L measurement bins exist. Owner confirmation of deployment policy remains open.

items.title: Chưa nghiệm thu H1/latency/timeout/fallback/replay sau expiry
items.resolution: Kept H1 and safe expiry/recovery guards. Development timeout profile is explicit; real latency budget, retention/late-ACK acceptance and pilot measurements cannot be certified locally.

items.title: M8: routing history/verification evidence còn CONTRACT_BLOCKED
items.resolution: Losslessly publish RoutingHistory and VerificationEvidence through existing Data SDN events; verified PostgreSQL persistence and replay. No new endpoint is invented.

items.title: Test SDN–PostgreSQL vẫn có thể STALE và suite timeout
items.resolution: Use real store ingestion with bulk fixture setup, DB clock and bounded catch-up; preserve original stale threshold. All three SDN PostgreSQL cases pass.

items.title: Loss còn âm khi thiếu packet log/receive raw count vượt sent
items.resolution: Receive overcount yields invalid/unknown loss, never negative or clamped. Raw validator deduplicates packet sequences and applies an explicit cohort deadline parameter.

items.title: Telemetry chưa write-ahead vào outbox trước HTTP
items.resolution: Telemetry write-ahead persists/fsyncs before first HTTP and retries through lifecycle. Demand/traffic journals also persist before delivery. Corrupt telemetry journal fails closed.

items.title: 4test snapshot/capture còn payload compact cũ
items.resolution: Canonical nested v1.4 snapshot fixtures, regenerated same-checkout producer captures and deterministic synthetic API fixture builder; SQL round-trip/replay coverage retained.

items.title: 2test telemetry còn trái coverage Data
items.resolution: Retained strict coverage: empty batches are rejected; integration fixture supplies all 24 measurable links.

items.title: Test dùng clock thật/client–DB nên không ổn định theo tải
items.resolution: Use Data DB time for availability boundaries and a controlled clock for the large HTTP snapshot unit fixture; no freshness relaxation.

items.title: CI chưa chạy main/PR và producer pins còn cũ
items.resolution: Workflow runs main/PR/manual events and imports the current checkout. Removed stale producer pins, added artifact environment locks and zero-skip PostgreSQL suite. Remote CI execution awaits publication.

items.title: Chưa có TC-I01/fault vòng kín trên baseline chung
items.resolution: Local module and real PostgreSQL evidence is available. Mininet/OVS whole-loop TC-I01 and F01-F12 pilot evidence have not been run; PASS_SYSTEM is not claimed.

items.title: Benchmark executor/results validator vẫn0byte
items.resolution: Implemented frozen M0-M4 Latin run order, separate fault runs, sequential explicit launcher, preserved failures, raw metric recomputation, coverage/checksums and paired schedule bootstrap API. No real benchmark or fault hook execution is claimed.

items.title: ID/warmup/gate trong tài liệu vẫn mâu thuẫn
items.resolution: Corrected canonical IDs and warm-up60 baseline; explicitly distinguished QA G1-G6 from Network/S0 and superseded historical advice.

items.title: Profile môi trường/lệnh test chưa thống nhất cho triển khai
items.resolution: Added separate Runner/ML lock and controller requirements, environment/role/path instructions and actual launch manifest contract. Linux controller/Mininet deployment still needs target environment execution.

items.title: README G0 còn endpoint cũ và code fence chưa đóng
items.resolution: Corrected native /apply endpoint, closed README code fence and distinguished rich audit records from strict HTTP wire payloads.

items.title: Main/ML còn9file pyc đã track
items.resolution: Removed all nine tracked pyc files from the integrated tree; ignore rules retain Python cache exclusions.

items.title: Sổ quyết định/calibration/deployment chưa cập nhật đầy đủ
items.resolution: Recorded implemented contracts and outstanding pilot/sign-off work. No owner identity, approval time, measured calibration or gate acceptance was fabricated.
